title: Sparkly piano
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- piano body -->
  <rect x="20" y="35" width="60" height="45" rx="4" fill="#5B3A8C"/>
  <!-- piano top -->
  <rect x="20" y="35" width="60" height="10" rx="3" fill="#7B5AAE"/>
  <!-- keyboard area -->
  <rect x="22" y="45" width="56" height="8" fill="#F0E6FF"/>
  <!-- black keys -->
  <rect x="30" y="45" width="4" height="5" fill="#3A2060"/>
  <rect x="38" y="45" width="4" height="5" fill="#3A2060"/>
  <rect x="50" y="45" width="4" height="5" fill="#3A2060"/>
  <rect x="58" y="45" width="4" height="5" fill="#3A2060"/>
  <rect x="66" y="45" width="4" height="5" fill="#3A2060"/>
  <!-- keys separators -->
  <line x1="34" y1="45" x2="34" y2="53" stroke="#C9B3E8" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="42" y1="45" x2="42" y2="53" stroke="#C9B3E8" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="46" y1="45" x2="46" y2="53" stroke="#C9B3E8" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="45" x2="54" y2="53" stroke="#C9B3E8" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="45" x2="62" y2="53" stroke="#C9B3E8" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="45" x2="70" y2="53" stroke="#C9B3E8" stroke-width="0.7"/>
  <!-- piano legs -->
  <rect x="26" y="80" width="6" height="8" rx="2" fill="#4A2E75"/>
  <rect x="68" y="80" width="6" height="8" rx="2" fill="#4A2E75"/>
  <!-- music stand -->
  <rect x="42" y="22" width="16" height="13" rx="2" fill="#8B6CC0"/>
  <rect x="44" y="24" width="12" height="2" fill="#D4C0F0"/>
  <rect x="44" y="28" width="12" height="2" fill="#D4C0F0"/>
  <rect x="44" y="32" width="8" height="2" fill="#D4C0F0"/>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFE566">
    <!-- sparkle 1 top left -->
    <polygon points="12,18 14,24 20,26 14,28 12,34 10,28 4,26 10,24"/>
    <!-- sparkle 2 top right -->
    <polygon points="84,14 86,20 92,22 86,24 84,30 82,24 76,22 82,20"/>
    <!-- sparkle 3 mid right -->
    <polygon points="90,50 91.5,54 96,55.5 91.5,57 90,61 88.5,57 84,55.5 88.5,54"/>
    <!-- sparkle 4 small left -->
    <polygon points="10,55 11.5,59 16,60.5 11.5,62 10,66 8.5,62 4,60.5 8.5,59"/>
    <!-- sparkle 5 bottom -->
    <polygon points="50,92 51.5,96 56,97.5 51.5,99 50,103 48.5,99 44,97.5 48.5,96"/>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkle 6 small top center -->
  <g fill="#FFF4A3">
    <polygon points="50,6 51,10 55,11 51,12 50,16 49,12 45,11 49,10"/>
    <polygon points="72,20 73,23 76,23.5 73,24 72,27 71,24 68,23.5 71,23"/>
  </g>
  <!-- tiny sparkles -->
  <g fill="#FFFFFF">
    <circle cx="25" cy="22" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="78" cy="38" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="88" cy="75" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="15" cy="78" r="1.2"/>
    <circle cx="65" cy="90" r="1"/>
    <circle cx="35" cy="88" r="1"/>
  </g>
</svg>
